title: PayloadCore
description: Shared payload definitions the kept payload schemas pull in by $ref (screen_verdict, doc_class: grounding_idx). v3's reserved payload core (evidence_tier, independence, relation, stance, date_asserted, confidence, the keys a v3 read policy could reference) is in v3's _core.schema.json (moved 2026-10-14).

grounding_idx.title: grounding_idx
grounding_idx.description: Indices into the annotation envelope's grounding array (annotations.grounding) that back the value(s) this record asserts. Payloads are quote-free: the verbatim quote/span/text_digest lives on the envelope, verified at write (§6.2); the payload points at it by position, as taxman does. May be empty only for an explicitly assessed-empty / unknown value that asserts thinness and therefore cites nothing.
